title: Missing-value handling protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Missing-value handling should complete this objective: Apply SimpleImputer. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Prepare incomplete datasets.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Fit the imputer on training data only and verify output shape.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for SimpleImputer, fit, transform and does not run the learner code. Fit the imputer on training data only and verify output shape.
